no_term_classes.note: P6b = matched host in [17.2, 19.0): BELOW the latent basis floor; the fold has NO term for it (matching_contract P6_RESIDUAL sub-slot b). hostless = the census P4+P6c, which the ORACLE FP term is pinned to.

stratum_allocation.note: fold-implied truth per (b,k,s) = truth_counts[b,k] * dX[k,s] / dX_tot[k] (f is not stratified) vs the MEASURED truth_counts_bks[b,k,s]

operator_efficiency.note: A_mod[b,K,s] = C_molly[s,b]*<g>_K*phi[s,K,b] vs the measured C_true_bKs (both = P(on-grid detection | truth in b,K,s))

completeness_vs_counting.note: C_det = P(detected | truth in b,K,s) regardless of the observed N-hat bin; phi = P(the detection lands on the [19.5,22.4) observed grid | detected).  C_true = C_det*phi.

counts_budget.note: ORACLE pins mu_FP to the census hostless array; the TP arm must then carry counts - hostless, i.e. the matched set PLUS every class the fold has no term for

deterministic_inversion._note: unpenalised non-negative Poisson MLE by EM (4000 iters, started at f_true); the committed model adds a 2-D RW prior, so these are the UNDAMPED operator-level predictions, not a posterior.  _selftest_exact_operator_on_matched folds the EMPIRICAL operator against the MATCHED counts: it must return ~0 (residual = z-migration + stratum allocation only).

collar_mismatch.note: the posterior runs consume scanpack_*_b300 whose counts/dX are at collar 3300 km/s while truth_counts/truth_counts_bks are the collar-3000 arrays copied byte-identically by build_scan_packs.py — so truth_f is built from a truth histogram on a WIDER selection than its own dX
